definition: Things regarded with intense disgust or hatred.
author: H. G. Wells
quote: As I thought of that, I was almost moved to begin a massacre of the helpless abominations about me, but I contained myself.
example_sentence: My aunt calls pineapple pizzas culinary abominations.
